scripts.build: node scripts/validate-project-data.mjs && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .ssg/server && vite build --outDir out --manifest && node scripts/generate-static.mjs && node scripts/verify-static-output.mjs
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply soma-projects --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply soma-projects --remote --config wrangler.remote.jsonc
scripts.d1:queue: wrangler d1 execute soma-projects --remote --config wrangler.remote.jsonc --command "SELECT id, title, project_type, status, created_at FROM project_submission WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC"
